Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: Misattribution and misintegration of evidence. The Planner incorrectly identified Chiang Kai-shek as Chiang Hsiao-chang’s father (despite WebSurfer showing her father is Chiang Ching-kuo) and prematurely concluded the “other child” was Chiang Wei-kuo. This contradicts the gathered data listing Hsiao-chang’s actual siblings and reflects a premature, unsupported synthesis.
